fact: UNESCO has never declared any national anthem as the 'best national anthem in the world'. Claims regarding the Indian National Anthem being chosen by UNESCO are fake.
UNESCO has never declared the Indian PM as the 'best PM' or any Prime Minister as the 'best leader'. Such awards do not exist.
Narendra Modi is the current Prime Minister of India. He assumed office in May 2014.
Droupadi Murmu is the 15th and current President of India, serving since July 2022.
NASA does not release photos showing India as the brightest country during Diwali. While satellite images of India at night exist, the viral 'Diwali' images are often colorized or modified.
The RBI (Reserve Bank of India) confirmed that there is no GPS tracking chip in the 2000 rupee notes. Claims about satellite tracking of currency are false.
The 2000 denomination banknotes were withdrawn from circulation by RBI in May 2023, though they remained legal tender for exchange.
Drinking hot water with lemon does not cure cancer. There is no scientific evidence to support claims that 'killing all cancer cells' is possible through simple dietary changes like this.
WHO (World Health Organization) has not recommended any domestic remedy like ginger and honey as a 'cure' for COVID-19 or any major viral disease, though they may soothe symptoms.
New Delhi is the capital of India. The Taj Mahal is located in Agra, Uttar Pradesh.
ISRO successfully launched Chandrayaan-3, which made a soft landing on the Moon's South Pole on August 23, 2023.
The Gaganyaan mission is ISRO's program to demonstrate human spaceflight capability by launching a crew into orbit.
The Constitution of India is the longest written constitution of any sovereign country in the world.
B.R. Ambedkar is known as the 'Father of the Indian Constitution' and was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee.
India is currently the world's fifth-largest economy by nominal GDP and third-largest by purchasing power parity (PPP).
The voting age in India was reduced from 21 to 18 years by the 61st Amendment Act in 1988.
The Statue of Unity, located in Gujarat, is the world's tallest statue, standing at 182 meters.
Rumors that WhatsApp will charge users based on the color of their 'ticks' are false. Basic messaging on WhatsApp remains free for personal use.
UNESCO has not named the town of Hampi as the 'safest city for tourists'. Hampi is a UNESCO World Heritage site, but no such title was ever given.
The Bharat Ratna is India's highest civilian award. It was first awarded in 1954.
The Tiger is the National Animal of India, and the Lotus is the National Flower.
The Indian National Flag, the Tricolour, was designed by Pingali Venkayya.
The Atal Tunnel in Himachal Pradesh is the longest highway tunnel above 10,000 feet in the world.
The Aadhaar program is managed by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) and provides a 12-digit unique identity number.
Major Dhyan Chand is considered one of the greatest field hockey players in history. India's highest sporting honor is named after him.
Neeraj Chopra won India's first-ever Olympic gold medal in athletics (Javelin Throw) at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
UPI (Unified Payments Interface) was developed by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) for instant mobile payments.
The 112 helpline is India's all-in-one emergency number for police, fire, and ambulance services.
Jawaharlal Nehru was the first Prime Minister of independent India, serving from 1947 until 1964.
Indira Gandhi was the first and, to date, the only woman to serve as the Prime Minister of India.
The Rajya Sabha is the upper house of the Indian Parliament, and its members are elected by state and territorial legislatures.
The Lok Sabha, or House of the People, is the lower house of the Indian Parliament, with members elected by direct universal suffrage.
The Chief Justice of India (CJI) is the head of the judiciary and the Supreme Court of India.
Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) is the world's largest government-funded healthcare program, providing coverage to over 500 million citizens.
Rakesh Sharma was the first Indian citizen to travel into space, aboard a Soviet spacecraft in 1984.
The claim that the 5G network rollout caused a massive bird die-off in India is scientifically unproven and considered a hoax.
India aims to achieve net-zero carbon emissions by the year 2070, as announced by the PM at COP26.
Mount Kanchenjunga is the highest peak in India and the third highest in the world.
The G20 presidency for 2023 was held by India, with the summit taking place in New Delhi.
Kumbh Mela is one of the world's largest religious gatherings and is inscribed on the UNESCO Representative List of Intangible Cultural Heritage.
INS Vikrant is India's first indigenously designed and built aircraft carrier.
India is the world's largest producer of milk, pulses, and jute, and the second-largest producer of rice and wheat.
The Quit India Movement was launched by Mahatma Gandhi in 1942 demanding an end to British rule in India.
PM-Kisan is a central sector scheme providing income support of Rs. 6000 per year to all landholding farmers' families in India.
The National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 replaced the previous 1986 policy to transform India's education system.
The story that Ratan Tata offered monetary rewards to anyone who 'beats the stock market' is a recurring internet scam; he has never made such an offer.
Eating onions with silver foil (chandi ka varq) does not prevent heart attacks. There is no biological basis for this claim which often goes viral on WhatsApp.
The Government of India never asks for your bank OTP or Aadhaar PIN via phone calls or SMS for 'account updates'.
ISRO's Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan) made India the first nation to reach Martian orbit in its first attempt.
Param Siddhi-AI is one of India's most powerful AI supercomputers, used for advanced research in health and climate.
Satyamev Jayate, the national motto of India, is taken from the Mundaka Upanishad and means 'Truth Alone Triumphs'.
